# How much tax will I pay on a pension withdrawal?

> Free UK pension withdrawal tax calculator: how much of a lump sum or UFPLS is tax-free, the tax you really owe, the emergency tax refund to expect and how spreading it over tax years saves. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
